about.title: About
about.heading: From IT support to software development.
paragraphs: I'm Ralph Christian Gabriel. I live in Repentigny, in Greater Montréal, and I study software engineering at ÉTS. I work in French and English.

I started in IT support at Vidéotron: more than 2,000 tickets resolved, and about half of the repetitive tasks automated with Power Automate. That's where I learned to listen and diagnose before proposing a fix.

Since then, I've been building web and mobile apps. The Mad Space, a print-on-demand marketplace, runs in production with Stripe payments in 4 currencies. This fall, I'm a process automation intern at La Caisse (CDPQ).

marathon.desc: I ran 21.1 km to support Laval firefighters. Months of training taught me what I also find in software development every day: consistency, trusting the process, and finishing what you start.

chess.title: Chess Player
chess.desc: Chess forces me to anticipate, read patterns, and think several moves ahead. That's exactly what I do when designing the architecture of a system.

skiing.title: Skier
skiing.desc: Skiing is my reset. It forces me to read the terrain, react quickly, and fully commit to every turn.

personality.title: How I work
personality.desc: I think in systems: I go deep before going wide, I plan before I code, and I document so what I ship keeps working without me. Curious and methodical, I'm most comfortable once I understand the "why" before the "how".
points: Diagnose before proposing: a habit from IT support.
Plan, then move in small, verifiable steps.
Document and test so the code lasts.
Keep learning, and share what I figure out.

now.title: Right now
now.body: Process automation intern at La Caisse (CDPQ) until December 2026: Power Apps, Power Automate and Copilot Studio in a regulated environment. On the side, I'm building Cadence with my co-founder and continuing my degree at ÉTS.

items.desc: Business process automation with Power Platform in a regulated environment.
points: Design and ship business process automation solutions for one of the world's largest institutional investors, under regulated production standards.
Lead stakeholder requirements workshops, map existing processes and prioritize automation opportunities across business units.
Integrate systems via REST APIs, connectors and SharePoint lists; own testing, documentation and production readiness.
items.stack: Power Apps · Power Automate · Copilot Studio · Dataverse · SharePoint · REST APIs

images.alt: Ralph at La Caisse headquarters, Montréal, October 2026
La Caisse intern cohort, fall 2026, Montréal

items.desc: Transport management system (TMS) integration for logistics clients.
points: Configured and integrated TMS solutions for logistics clients through database parameterization and component adaptation.
Integrated Google Maps geocoding and third-party routing APIs for transport routing and trip optimization.
Delivered 3+ structured test, development and production releases within an Agile team.
items.stack: TMS · REST APIs · Google Maps · GitLab CI/CD · Spring Boot · Angular

items.desc: Print-on-demand marketplace, designed and shipped end to end.
points: Architected and shipped an end-to-end print-on-demand marketplace: ~15,000 lines of code, 30+ REST endpoints, 17 bilingual pages, multi-role authentication, 4 currencies and 20+ CI/CD deployments to production.
Automated 4 business workflows across 7 third-party APIs (Stripe, Gelato, Google Merchant Center, GA4, Google Ads), cutting order processing by 10 to 15 minutes per order.
Implemented production-grade security (OAuth 2.0 with refresh-token rotation, HMAC-signed webhooks, rate limiting, audit logs), compliant with GDPR and Quebec Laws 25 and 96.
items.stack: Next.js · TypeScript · Prisma · PostgreSQL · Supabase · Stripe · Vercel

items.desc: Sports coaching mobile app for the Quebec market.
points: Architecting a mobile sports coaching app for the Quebec francophone market, with a landing page live on Vercel.
Ran 13 sprints and 169+ GitHub issues with strict acceptance criteria; security by design (Supabase RLS from the first sprint, OWASP Mobile audit planned).
items.stack: Expo (React Native) · TypeScript · NativeWind · Supabase · Vercel

items.desc: Prototypes and websites for clients, and my own products.
points: Clients: Kim Dubois Photographe (my first paying client), BOA (private chef) and the Cornwall Rex Club of Canada.
Products: DPM Elevate (deployed planning app), Wise & Wealthy and Vibe Montréal (prototypes).
Design systems, bilingual sites, light and dark themes; production targeted in Next.js and TypeScript.

items.desc: IT support and task automation with Power Automate.
points: Automated about 50% of recurring HR, IT and Finance tasks with Power Automate; wrote runbooks that sped up technician onboarding.
Resolved 2,000+ support tickets (94% customer satisfaction, 9.6/10).
items.stack: Power Automate · Microsoft 365 · Level 1 and 2 support

services.heading: What I can bring you.
services.intro: A site to launch, an idea to validate or a team to strengthen: here's what I can do. Every example links to a real project.

items.title: Web sites and applications
items.problem: A site that doesn't convert, a patched-together internal tool, or no web presence at all.
items.deliver: A fast, accessible bilingual web app, from design through to launch. Usually on Next.js, TypeScript and PostgreSQL.
items.example: The Mad Space, a marketplace in production.

items.title: Prototypes and web/mobile MVPs
items.problem: An idea that's hard to show to clients, partners or investors.
items.deliver: An interactive, clickable prototype that makes the idea testable, then a codebase ready for what's next.
items.example: Wise & Wealthy, a concept turned into a full, testable mockup.

items.title: Integrations and automation
items.audience: Teams losing time on manual tasks
items.problem: Data retyped by hand, payments or emails to wire up, slow processes.
items.deliver: Integrations (payments, print production and shipping, third-party APIs) and automation that remove the manual steps.
items.example: The Mad Space: 7 third-party APIs integrated and orders processed automatically.

items.title: Strengthening a team
items.problem: You're looking for a versatile, self-driven profile who can deliver from design through to production.
items.deliver: A full-stack developer who designs, codes, tests and ships, and documents so the team can keep up.
items.example: DPM Elevate, a complete app designed and delivered solo.

testimonials.quote: Christian created a professional, modern website perfectly suited to my needs. His professionalism, creativity, and clear communication made the entire process smooth and efficient.
testimonials.author: Founder

testimonials.quote: Ralph took charge of the team during our Testing and Maintenance course projects. He got to know each team member to assign tasks that suited them best, always keeping things fair and balanced. He was always available to answer questions, patient, and ready to help. He's someone who constantly works to improve himself and bring out the best in his teammates. Simply put, he's an excellent leader.
testimonials.author: Jonathan Euclide Marc

testimonials.quote: Ralph stood out through his professionalism and team spirit. He was always there to support me when I was struggling, and what struck me most was his patience. No matter how complex the situation, he took the time to explain, guide, and make sure everything was properly resolved. I recommend him without hesitation.
testimonials.author: Sunny Mélissa Gabriel

testimonials.quote: Ralph Christian Gabriel is an expert in his field! He helped me on numerous occasions with my computer technical issues. He is reliable and always perseveres to find solutions to problems. I greatly appreciated that he always took the time to explain the reasoning behind his plan of action. This demonstrated, in my opinion, his thoroughness but also his dedication to the satisfaction of the people he helps.
testimonials.author: Anne Sofie Laurent

testimonials.quote: When I wanted to bring the idea of Cadence to life, Ralph was the first person I thought of to join me on this adventure. A former classmate, Ralph has always shown exceptional rigor. He quickly demonstrated the same rigor and expertise as a business partner. He approaches every problem with genuine deep thinking: he considers the architecture, anticipates issues, and delivers clean, maintainable work. What particularly impressed me is his ability to learn fast and adapt to the real constraints of a project under construction. He took on complex technical challenges autonomously while remaining a reliable thinking partner. I would recommend Ralph at any time without the slightest hesitation.
testimonials.author: Alexandre Boisvert
